title: insurer quote feed payload
description: One quote feed per adopter (policy-composition ticket 14; ADR-0019, ADR-0021). The insurer prices under its own perspective (kind=insurer in the envelope's perspective vocabulary) from the platform and the adopter's own signed exposure, pinned as parents on party.yaml's inherits[]. The pricing seat that produces this payload is ticket 36 (not built yet); this schema fixes its shape so a consumer can pin it now. Every price carries its own perspective and currency (spec.md); no sum here crosses into the adopter's own prices[].

adopter.description: The adopter party this quote covers, e.g. 'driftwood'. One feed name (path) per adopter.

priced_against.description: The signed source this quote is priced from -- the adopter's exposure artefact, pinned the same way any inherits[] entry is.

attachment.description: The retention -- losses below this are the adopter's own, seen from the insurer's side. Equal to the adopter's own appetite.attachment.

exclusions.description: Keyed on the same obligation regime names and control ids the composition already prices on, so the quote reads the artefact the adopter signed.

premium.description: Booked as a contract cost line under the adopter's own perspective, beside costs.fix -- never summed with the insurer's own TVaR arithmetic.

perspective.description: The perspective this quote's own pricing arithmetic (premium calculation) is booked under -- 'insurer'. Distinct from which perspective the resulting premium cost line lands in (the adopter's).

currency.description: The currency this payload's own figures (attachment, limit, premium) are stated in before any restatement.

conditions.description: Carrier vocabulary: a named condition of cover and what happens if it is not met.
